references.label: Attic playfield
references.description: Upper secondary playfield with reversed-looking flipper geometry, drop targets, and exits to the Main Floor or Cellar.

references.label: Main Floor
references.description: Primary playfield with two right flippers, the upper-entry ramp, Trap Door, center hole, and floor-scoped scoring flags.

references.label: Cellar playfield
references.description: Lower reversed-view playfield whose drop bank is the preferred route to opposite-floor and Main Floor Double Scoring.

references.label: Trap Door
references.description: Far-right Main Floor shot that transfers the ball into the Cellar.

references.label: Cellar up-kicker
references.description: Mechanism that returns the ball from the Cellar toward the upper Main Floor left flipper.
